$comment: Fill in `command` with YOUR text-to-speech CLI as an argv array (no shell).
Tokens: {text} (the line, emoji removed), {who} (mentor|guru), {voice} (from `voices` below), {voiceDescription} (casting notes from audio-manifest.json), {file} (absolute .mp3 path), {id}.
`voices`: whatever your CLI needs to pick a voice for each speaker (a voice id or name). Leave null to use {voiceDescription} with a voice-design model instead.
The flags in `shape` are placeholders, not real flags. Learn the real ones from your CLI's --help (the generate-media skill does this).
